summary: Frontend-only Phase-1 Console redesign QA focused on /customers (The Dev Store, company 1). Logged in via 2-step + TOTP, verified all required data-testids, light + dark modes, desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Smoke-tested /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links. No console errors observed. All critical testids present and functional. Read-only — no data mutated.

issues: Minor UX inconsistency: KPI tile 'customers-stat-customers' shows 11 while the segment/count label on the right of FilterBar reads '15 customers'. The 4 extra are the aggregated 'anonymous' rows (API/Payment Link/Direct). Not a regression from this session, but may confuse merchants — consider aligning both numbers or clarifying the KPI label.

action_items: Optional: reconcile the KPI 'Customers=11' vs FilterBar '15 customers' label on /customers so users don't see two different totals.

Optional: /pay-links uses data-testid='paylink-row' (not row-scoped by id) while the review request implied 'paylink-row-<id>' — rows are still clickable but any id-suffixed selector will miss. Consider using 'paylink-row-<id>' for parity with 'tx-row-<id>' and 'customer-row-<id>'.
critical_code_review_comments: Console SummaryStrip renders a true 2x2 grid at 390px (gridTemplateColumns measured as two tracks ~156px/167px). No horizontal overflow at 390px in either light or dark mode.
Console FilterBar wraps search + Most-recent sort + Add + Export cleanly in both themes; all four testids present and clickable.
ConsoleEmptyState correctly renders for segments with zero rows (repeat / dormant / new) with wrapper 'customers-empty-state' + inner 'customers-empty-inner'.
Customer detail drawer opens on both desktop row click and mobile card click; close button restores list; name field populated.
No console errors across /customers, /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links during the session.
seed_data_creation: None (SAFE MODE read-only on production DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-1 Console redesign on /customers verified end-to-end (desktop+mobile, light+dark). SummaryStrip/FilterBar/EmptyState shared kit from @/Components/Console/* wired correctly. Other three Phase-1 pages (/dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links) load without errors and keep their key testids (dash2026-root, transactions-status-chips, tx-row-*, detail-slide-over, paylink-row). Note /pay-links uses bare 'paylink-row' testid (not id-suffixed).
